parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main globe body made of plastic, representing the Earth with printed maps.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface for geographical information and can rotate around its axis for viewing different regions.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly around a tilted axis supported by the circular frame.

parts.name: Circle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This circular ring is a metallic support structure that holds the globe sphere in place.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rotational support and defines the axis tilt of the globe, allowing the sphere to spin freely.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing the sphere to rotate within it.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is a wooden stand with vertical supports that hold the circular frame and globe sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and elevation to the globe, ensuring it remains upright and balanced.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move; it supports the entire structure.
